text:
商店的货架是一格格栏位，商品是真的道具，看得见尺寸。把商品拖进自己的包就是买，放手时收钱，钱不够弹回架上；双击也是买，自动找位。把自己的东西拖进出售区就是卖，回定价的三成（带回基地卖是五成）。卖错了按「回购」，原价买回最近卖掉的那件；离开商店就不能回购了。价格按道具的价值乘倍数，深处的店货更稀有。

刷新花钱换一批，每刷一次更贵。商店可以回头再逛：走了再回来，货架、刷新次数和卖掉的格子都还记着，刷新价不重置。珍宝不上架，货架上有时会摆一个包。局外的加成能让商店便宜一点。

texts.en:
The Shop's shelves are grids of slots, and the wares are real items, so you can see their size. Dragging a ware into one of your bags buys it: you pay when you let go, and if you can't afford it, it snaps back to the shelf. Double-clicking also buys, finding a place for it automatically. Dragging your own things into the sell area sells them for three tenths of their price (half if you take them back to base). Sold the wrong thing? Press Buy back to get the most recent sale back at the price you got; once you leave the Shop, buy-back is gone. Prices are an item's Value times a multiplier, and shops deeper in stock rarer goods.

Refreshing costs coins and brings a new selection, and each refresh costs more than the last. You can come back to a shop: leave and return, and it still remembers its shelves, how many times you refreshed and which slots are sold out; the refresh price doesn't reset. Treasures are never for sale; sometimes a shelf holds a Bag. Bonuses from between runs can make shops a little cheaper.
